annotations.title: Change or remove a line of a list

description: Reads, changes or removes lines of a list (another tab of the track's sheet, see add_to_list). With trackId and tab alone it gives the list's newest lines, each with its row, its print, what it shows, and mine (whether this person may change it). To change one, send its row and print with values: only the columns you name change, and an empty value empties that cell. To remove one, send its row and print with remove: true, after the person said to. A change lands only while the line still says what you read, so read again if it's refused as changed. Edited by and Edited at columns are filled when the tab has them.

print.description: The line's print, from the listing.

row.description: The line's row, from the listing.

tab.description: The tab's name, as the sheet shows it.

values.description: The columns to change: each key or header to its new value.
